name: tuple-variable-reference-test-b0bbe9bfef/tuple-variable-reference-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions: positive list includes "Type test expression" but does not list typeof expressions
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only "message"
Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions" includes "error:message", not error:detail
reason: The case requires nested list destructuring assignments such as [[a, b], c] = [["UpdatedBallerina", 453], false], which exceed the explicit wildcard-only restriction. This is decisive for feature classification even though many surrounding ordinary expressions and declarations are supported. Executed rest-pattern tests additionally assert typeof-derived typedesc rendering (typeof is not covered) and call error.detail(), which is excluded by the langlib allowlist. Output markers exercise the destructured values, so the unsupported operation is essential.
unsupported_constructs: List and nested/rest list destructuring assignments instead of wildcard-only destructuring
typeof expressions and asserted typedesc string rendering
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: basic tuple assignments, classes, arrays, unions, rest bindings, readonly values, and runtime typedesc assertions are bundled into one executable case.
Only @output markers appear; later rest/readonly tests run via assertions without output markers. io:println is instrumentation.
